why does doing `vpr docs:dev` and then switching to an untranslated language on a page throw a 404, I thought itwas supposed to fall back to the english strings.
http://localhost:5173/da/api/

Confirmed: `docs:dev` runs `docs:api:en` only, which builds English API docs. Per-locale API docs (`docs/da/api/`) are only generated by `docs:api:locales`/`docs:dev:all`. So `/da/api/` doesn't exist as a file at all under plain `docs:dev` — VitePress doesn't do content-level fallback to English source files; it just 404s if the localized route has no source file.

content.text:
This confirms the mechanism directly. Now I have the answer.

## Answer

There's no "fall back to English strings for missing pages" mechanism in VitePress — locales are just separate routed directories (`docs/da/**`), and if a file (or generated dir) doesn't exist under a locale prefix, that route simply 404s. This repo doesn't build content-level fallback; it relies on keeping every locale's directory in parity (`docs/scripts/check-locale-parity.ts`).

The actual bug you hit is that **`vpr docs:dev` never generates locale API docs at all**:

- [docs/package.json](docs/package.json)'s `docs:dev` script runs `docs:api:en` (English-only TypeDoc build), not `docs:api:locales`. So `docs/da/api/` (and every other locale's `api/`) is never created locally.
- `docs:api:locales` (invoked by `docs:build:all`/`docs:dev:all`) is the script that actually clones the English TypeDoc output into each locale folder (e.g. `docs/da/api/`) and machine-translates it.
- The production build (`docs:build`) works around this differently: it sets `DOCS_ROOT_LOCALE_ONLY=1`, which adds `${locale}/api/**` to `srcExclude` in [docs/.vitepress/config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts#L625) — pruning non-root API routes from the site entirely rather than trying to serve them.

So under plain `docs:dev`, visiting `/da/api/` 404s because that directory genuinely doesn't exist on disk yet. To see localized API docs locally, run `vp run docs:dev:all` instead (or `vp run docs:api:locales` once, then `vp run docs:dev`).
